walls.notes: University Museum of Zoology entrance (under the David Attenborough Building deck): a full-height dark-framed glazed screen with glass double doors under a deep red-brick fascia band carrying the museum name sign, a brick pier with a notice board at the south end, a concrete column at the north end (pilaster); above the fascia, a railed deck and the set-back ribbon-glazed upper storey (projected onto this plane). From the Commons/geograph photo of the main entrance (CC BY-SA 2.0); widths estimated.
